ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, there are two points A and B on the outer edge of the protractor, and their readings are $70^\circ$ and $40^\circ$ respectively. What is the degree measure of $\angle 1$?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a semicircular protractor, with the center point labeled O. Points A and B are located on the outer arc of the protractor, and beside them are labeled A70° and B40° respectively. From O, connect respectively to A and B, forming the central angle ∠AOB; a point on the circumference at the lower left is connected to A and B, forming the inscribed angle labeled ∠1. Reasoning: The readings of A and B on the protractor are 70° and 40° respectively, so the corresponding central angle ∠AOB = 70° - 40° = 30°. ∠1 is an inscribed angle intercepting the same arc AB, therefore it is equal to half of the central angle: ∠1 = 1/2 × 30° = 15°.
